+    """Force the sampler-candidate recording fields for score centering.
+    The candidate count is a launch constraint (``config.rollout_top_logprobs_num``),
+    so a differing client value is rejected rather than merged, exactly like a
+    training-temperature mismatch. Under bounded sampling the candidates are
+    the realized support, so ``sampling_logprobs_mode="support"`` replaces any
+    client ``top_logprobs`` (the launch value wins; the client's own top-k
+    view of the full distribution is not the behavior distribution).
+                f"sampling_logprobs_mode={value!r} is not accepted: score centering records "

+            f"top_logprobs={value!r} does not match the training session's "
